name: effect-pixelate
title: Pixelate
description: Hình bị vẽ thô thành các khối pixel lớn rồi mịn dần từng bậc tới rõ nét, kiểu game cổ.

moworks.author: moworks

options.period: s for a there-and-back (3), stepping through whole numbers

credit.author: Moworks Studio
credit.madeNote: the studio's own motion, written here

moworks.notes: Picture drawn at low resolution and scaled up without smoothing: block size 32 -> 16 -> 8 -> 4 -> 1 px, 120 ms per step (steps, no tween), 600 ms total; reverse for an exit. Demo: the low-res width steps through every integer 32 -> 4 -> 32 pixels across the frame (blocks 10 -> 80 px on 320) on a 3 s |sine| yoyo. Params: steps (32 → 16 → 8 → 4 → 1 px) · duration mỗi bậc (0.12 s). An SVG filter samples one pixel per block and dilates it, so the picture is pixelated without smoothing; the small demo's steps are 32 → 16 → 8 → 4 → 1 px at 0.12 s each.
moworks.titleVi: Vỡ hạt pixel rồi rõ dần
